verdict.rationale: Any documented open-source project could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this story applies to vLLM. The evidence shows none: the probe of https://docs.vllm.ai/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no cited docs describe agent-oriented documentation. The tool-calling and OpenAI-compatible API features concern model serving, not docs an agent can consume, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
